public_rationale: The searched records do not establish the claimed decline in cohort value. Company-wide losses and the existence of serving costs cannot show whether the heaviest free users became less valuable after conversion and other benefits are included. The comparison with Facebook and Google is also unmeasured. The unspecified accounting basis independently prevents a supported or contradicted monetary finding.
limitations: Value and heavy usage are not quantitatively defined.
Public aggregate financial information cannot substitute for cohort economics.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: ChatGPT's heaviest free users become less valuable over time and a cost burden, unlike free users of Facebook or Google.

statement.excerpt: Unlike Facebook and Google, ChatGPT’s most frequent free users actually become less valuable over time, and become a burden on a system that already burns money.

our_interpretation: Value means net economic value to the provider, including serving costs and benefits from conversion, referrals and useful training data.
A decline over time requires evidence following comparable users or cohorts. Positive inference costs alone do not establish declining net value.
The comparison also requires evidence about comparable Facebook and Google users.
Because this is an ongoing observation without dates, I use July through September 2024, the latest completed calendar quarter before publication.
The claim supplies no accounting basis, currency, valuation method or threshold for the most frequent users.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable cohort evidence shows declining net economic value and a net cost burden from persistent heavy free ChatGPT use during the target period, alongside a different trajectory for comparable Facebook and Google users.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable cohort evidence shows that heavy free ChatGPT users maintained or increased net economic value, were not a net burden, or did not differ from the comparison services as claimed.

evidence.explanation: Changing model costs make a fixed-cost assumption unsafe. This qualitative company statement does not measure internal serving costs or the net value of heavy free-user cohorts.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Historical cohort accounts or transparent estimates covering heavy free users' costs and attributable benefits over time, with an explicit valuation basis and comparable Facebook and Google cohorts.
